title: Mineral formulae (APFU)
text: One row per analysis, identifier column called specimen one column per oxide, named oxide table package (SiO2, Al2O3, FeO, Fe2O3, H2O_plus, …). oxides must last columns table, starting SiO2. Missing oxides can NA; treated zero. package ships three small example tables textbook compositions (Deer, Howie & Zussman): chemical_formula() returns specimen plus one column per cation (normalization bases), result joined back input specimen.
code: read_ex <- function(file) {   read.csv(system.file("extdata", file, package = "ztR")) %>%     select(specimen, mineral, everything(), -X) }  tourmaline <- read_ex("tourmaline_DHZ.csv") garnet     <- read_ex("garnet_DHZ.csv") epidote    <- read_ex("epidote_DHZ.csv")  garnet #>   specimen     mineral  SiO2 TiO2 Al2O3 Cr2O3 Fe2O3   FeO   MnO   MgO   CaO #> 1        1      pyrope 41.33 0.28 21.83  1.73  1.44  9.00  0.44 19.60  4.40 #> 2        2   almandine 36.70 0.75 21.40    NA    NA 29.90  1.14  0.90  9.02 #> 3        3 spessartine 36.34 0.10 20.25    NA  0.92  7.30 34.51    NA  0.44 #> 4        4   grossular 39.04 0.12 20.43    NA  3.29  1.81  0.34  0.73 34.29 #> 5        5   andradite 36.48 0.50  6.80    NA 21.94  3.33  0.56  0.00 30.22 #> 6        6   uvarovite 36.77   NA  8.36 13.72  5.85    NA  0.22  0.27 34.56

title: Mineral formulae (APFU)
text: End-member proportions follow directly X-site cations:
code: gt <- garnet %>%   select(specimen, mineral) %>%   left_join(chemical_formula(garnet, oxigens = 24, cations = 16), by = "specimen")  gt %>% select(mineral, Si, Al, Fe, Fe3, Mn, Mg, Ca) #>       mineral       Si       Al        Fe       Fe3         Mn        Mg #> 1      pyrope 5.948124 3.702747 1.0832111 0.1733138 0.05363555 4.2051279 #> 2   almandine 5.898086 4.053354 4.0185762 0.0000000 0.15517986 0.2156235 #> 3 spessartine 6.006392 3.944659 1.0090382 0.1271665 4.83124612 0.0000000 #> 4   grossular 5.977115 3.686429 0.2317482 0.4212439 0.04409062 0.1666146 #> 5   andradite 6.266296 1.376641 0.4783616 3.1517276 0.08147597 0.0000000 #> 6   uvarovite 5.999195 1.607538 0.0000000 0.7981991 0.03040237 0.0656707 #>           Ca #> 1 0.67846105 #> 2 1.55313501 #> 3 0.07791823 #> 4 5.62479775 #> 5 5.56170768 #> 6 6.04130471 gt %>%   mutate(x_site = Fe + Mn + Mg + Ca,          Alm = Fe / x_site, Sps = Mn / x_site, Prp = Mg / x_site, Grs = Ca / x_site) %>%   select(mineral, Alm:Grs) %>%   pivot_longer(Alm:Grs, names_to = "end_member", values_to = "fraction") %>%   ggplot(aes(mineral, fraction, fill = end_member)) +   geom_col() +   labs(x = NULL, y = "Molar fraction", fill = NULL) +   theme_minimal()

title: U-Pb geochronology and concordia diagrams
text: use_isoplotr() needs three ratios 2σ absolute uncertainties. error correlations rho_206pb_238u_v_207pb_235u (Wetherill) rho_207pb_206pb_v_238u_206pb (Tera-Wasserburg) used present; otherwise IsoplotR infers redundancy three ratios. Every uncertainty column ending _2s 2σ. disc_c concordia-distance discordance (%) Vermeesch (2021); definitions available discordance ("r", "t", "", "sk", see IsoplotR::discfilter()).
code: ages <- use_isoplotr(zr40, legacy = FALSE) #> 18 row(s) with missing or non-positive ratios/errors: ages set to NA.  ages %>%   select(sample, age_68, age_68_2s, age_76, age_76_2s, age_conc, age_conc_2s, p_conc, disc_c) %>%   head() #> # A tibble: 6 × 9 #>   sample age_68 age_68_2s age_76 age_76_2s age_conc age_conc_2s p_conc disc_c #>   <chr>   <dbl>     <dbl>  <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>       <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl> #> 1 91500   1067.        NA   954.        NA    1063.          NA     NA -4.20  #> 2 91500   1071.        NA  1282.        NA    1074.          NA     NA  8.48  #> 3 91500   1069.        NA  1120.        NA    1070.          NA     NA  1.98  #> 4 91500   1050.        NA  1061.        NA    1051.          NA     NA  0.417 #> 5 91500   1053.        NA  1020.        NA    1052.          NA     NA -1.25  #> 6 91500   1069.        NA   942.        NA    1067.          NA     NA -4.94

title: U-Pb geochronology and concordia diagrams
text: single-grain concordia age makes IsoplotR slow (tens milliseconds per grain). 7/5, 6/8 7/6 ages needed, concordia = FALSE 20 times faster:
code: all_ages <- use_isoplotr(zircons, concordia = FALSE, legacy = FALSE) #> 19 row(s) with missing or non-positive ratios/errors: ages set to NA. nrow(all_ages) #> [1] 3099

title: U-Pb geochronology and concordia diagrams
text: table also carries ages exported Iolite (pb206_u238_age, pb207_pb206_age, …), gives direct check calculation: 206Pb/238U ages agree within tenths percent (median offset 3 Ma 1065 Ma 91500, 0.2 Ma Plešovice). 207Pb/235U ages systematically older IsoplotR, ~3% low-Pb reference materials. likely reason Iolite reports mean ages integration, whereas IsoplotR computes age mean ratio; noisy 207Pb signals two diverge. 206Pb/238U uncertainties identical:
code: all_ages %>%   transmute(sample,             `206Pb/238U` = age_68 - pb206_u238_age,             `207Pb/235U` = age_75 - pb207_u235_age) %>%   pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "system", values_to = "difference") %>%   group_by(sample, system) %>%   summarise(median_Ma = median(difference, na.rm = TRUE),             p95_abs_Ma = quantile(abs(difference), 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),             .groups = "drop") #> # A tibble: 8 × 4 #>   sample system     median_Ma p95_abs_Ma #>   <chr>  <chr>          <dbl>      <dbl> #> 1 91500  206Pb/238U     2.99      18.1   #> 2 91500  207Pb/235U    29.9       71.0   #> 3 FC-1   206Pb/238U     2.28      10.0   #> 4 FC-1   207Pb/235U    11.0       32.7   #> 5 PCIGR1 206Pb/238U     0.371      0.510 #> 6 PCIGR1 207Pb/235U    31.7       42.1   #> 7 PL     206Pb/238U     0.228      1.30  #> 8 PL     207Pb/235U     3.66       8.84 all_ages %>%   summarise(ratio_2s = median(age_68_2s / pb206_u238_age_2s, na.rm = TRUE), .by = sample) #> # A tibble: 4 × 2 #>   sample ratio_2s #>   <chr>     <dbl> #> 1 91500        NA #> 2 PCIGR1       NA #> 3 PL           NA #> 4 FC-1         NA

what: 3. Median ages of the reference materials
title: U-Pb geochronology and concordia diagrams
text: Reference values: 91500 ≈ 1065 Ma (Wiedenbeck et al. 1995), Plešovice ≈ 337 Ma (Sláma et al. 2008), FC-1 ≈ 1099 Ma (Paces & Miller 1993).
code: ages %>%   summarise(n = n(),             concordia_age = median(age_conc, na.rm = TRUE),             age_68 = median(age_68, na.rm = TRUE),             .by = sample) #> # A tibble: 4 × 4 #>   sample     n concordia_age age_68 #>   <chr>  <int>         <dbl>  <dbl> #> 1 91500     40         1062.  1061. #> 2 PCIGR1    40         1060.  1065. #> 3 PL        40          335.   335. #> 4 FC-1      40         1096.  1096.

title: U-Pb geochronology and concordia diagrams
text: geom_concordia() draws one error ellipse per row x, y, sigma_x, sigma_y rho. default ellipse 95% confidence region; sigma_level = 2 tells layer uncertainties mapped sigma_x/sigma_y 2σ. geom_concordia_line() adds concordia curve age markers.

title: U-Pb geochronology and concordia diagrams
text: concordia line drawn age_range, also sets far plot extends; choose around ages data. line know facets, draw one diagram per sample (per age window) rather faceting samples different ages.
code: zr40 %>%   filter(sample == "91500") %>%   ggplot(aes(x = pb207_u235, y = pb206_u238,              sigma_x = pb207_u235_2s, sigma_y = pb206_u238_2s,              rho = rho_206pb_238u_v_207pb_235u)) +   geom_concordia_line(age_range = c(950, 1200), ticks = seq(950, 1200, 50)) +   geom_concordia(sigma_level = 2, alpha = 0.4, fill = "steelblue", colour = "grey30",                  linewidth = 0.2) +   labs(title = "91500", x = "207Pb/235U", y = "206Pb/238U") +   theme_bw()

title: U-Pb geochronology and concordia diagrams
text: Build 238U/206Pb uncertainty 206Pb/238U, use Tera-Wasserburg correlation:
code: zr40 %>%   filter(sample == "PL") %>%   mutate(u238_pb206 = 1 / pb206_u238,          u238_pb206_2s = pb206_u238_2s / pb206_u238^2) %>%   ggplot(aes(x = u238_pb206, y = pb207_pb206,              sigma_x = u238_pb206_2s, sigma_y = pb207_pb206_2s,              rho = rho_207pb_206pb_v_238u_206pb)) +   geom_concordia_line("tw", age_range = c(300, 380), ticks = seq(300, 380, 20)) +   geom_concordia(sigma_level = 2, alpha = 0.4, fill = "darkorange", colour = "grey30",                  linewidth = 0.2) +   labs(title = "Plesovice (PL)", x = "238U/206Pb", y = "207Pb/206Pb") +   theme_bw()

title: U-Pb geochronology and concordia diagrams
text: aesthetic can mapped. ellipses filled concordia-distance discordance, IsoplotR’s default cutoff (−2% +5.8%) marked outline:
code: ages %>%   filter(sample == "91500") %>%   mutate(concordant = between(disc_c, -2, 5.8)) %>%   ggplot(aes(x = pb207_u235, y = pb206_u238,              sigma_x = pb207_u235_2s, sigma_y = pb206_u238_2s,              rho = rho_206pb_238u_v_207pb_235u)) +   geom_concordia_line(age_range = c(900, 1250), ticks = seq(950, 1200, 50)) +   geom_concordia(aes(fill = disc_c, colour = concordant), sigma_level = 2,                  alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3) +   scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", limits = c(-15, 15), oob = scales::squish) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "grey20", `FALSE` = "red")) +   labs(x = "207Pb/235U", y = "206Pb/238U", fill = "disc (%)") +   theme_bw()

title: U-Pb geochronology and concordia diagrams
text: use_isoplotr() tidy_isoplotr() still return old columns default (legacy = TRUE). old s_2_* columns hold 1σ values (always ); use *_2s columns instead. version 0.0.0.9001 data read wrong IsoplotR format, old 207/206 ages, concordia ages discordances recomputed. add_concordia_line() still works, axes transposed (x = 206Pb/238U, y = 207Pb/235U). Use geom_concordia_line() new plots. geom_concordia() now draws 95% ellipses default; level = NULL reproduces old 1σ ellipses.

title: Zircon trace-element geochemistry
text: interpreting anything, check precise element . relative 2σ uncertainty REE per reference material:  LREE (La, Pr) close detection limit zircon carry large uncertainties; ratios using (e.g. Ce/Ce*) read care.
code: zircons %>%   select(sample, spot, all_of(ree), all_of(paste0(ree, "_2s"))) %>%   pivot_longer(-c(sample, spot)) %>%   mutate(kind = if_else(str_detect(name, "_2s$"), "s2", "value"),          name = str_remove(name, "_2s$")) %>%   pivot_wider(names_from = kind, values_from = value) %>%   mutate(error_pct = 100 * s2 / value,          element = fct_inorder(str_to_title(str_remove(name, "[0-9]+")))) %>%   filter(error_pct > 0, error_pct < 200) %>%   ggplot(aes(element, error_pct)) +   geom_violin(fill = "grey80", colour = NA) +   geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +   facet_wrap(~ sample) +   labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative uncertainty (2s, %)") +   theme_minimal()

title: Zircon trace-element geochemistry
text: normalize() divides element CI chondrite McDonough & Sun (1995) adds normalized columns suffix _N. reference tables can chosen database (e.g. "taylor_mcclennan_1985.csv" upper continental crust). spider diagram normalized REE:
code: zn <- normalize(zircons, element_vector = c(y89, la139:lu175)) zn %>% select(sample, la139_N:lu175_N) %>% head(3) #> # A tibble: 3 × 15 #>   sample  la139_N ce140_N pr141_N nd146_N sm147_N eu153_N gd157_N tb159_N #>   <chr>     <dbl>   <dbl>   <dbl>   <dbl>   <dbl>   <dbl>   <dbl>   <dbl> #> 1 91500   0.00166    4.06  0.0934   0.482    2.32    3.75    10.7    20.8 #> 2 91500  NA          3.96  0.0820   0.281    3.90    3.65    13.1    22.7 #> 3 91500   0.00704    4.12  0.131    0.623    3.37    4.84    11.2    23.9 #> # ℹ 6 more variables: dy163_N <dbl>, ho165_N <dbl>, er166_N <dbl>, #> #   tm169_N <dbl>, yb172_N <dbl>, lu175_N <dbl> zn %>%   filter(spot <= 60) %>%   select(sample, spot, paste0(ree, "_N")) %>%   pivot_longer(-c(sample, spot), values_to = "value") %>%   filter(value >= 1e-3) %>%          # drop values at or below detection limit   mutate(element = fct_inorder(str_to_title(str_remove(name, "[0-9]+_N")))) %>%   ggplot(aes(element, value, group = spot)) +   geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +   scale_y_log10() +   facet_wrap(~ sample) +   labs(x = NULL, y = "Sample / CI chondrite") +   theme_minimal()

title: Zircon trace-element geochemistry
text: ratio_calculator() adds common zircon ratios one step. needs normalized REE plus raw concentrations Ce, U, Ti, Hf Y (ppm) crystallization age best_age (Ma), used correct U decay oxybarometer. Use legacy = FALSE columns named compute (see ?ratio_calculator).
code: zr <- zn %>%   ratio_calculator(legacy = FALSE)  zr %>%   group_by(sample) %>%   summarise(across(c(eu_eu, ce_ce, dy_yb, yb_gd, lree_hree, hf_y, fmq, ti_temp),                    ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) #> # A tibble: 4 × 9 #>   sample  eu_eu   ce_ce dy_yb yb_gd lree_hree  hf_y   fmq ti_temp #>   <chr>   <dbl>   <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>     <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>   <dbl> #> 1 91500  0.783  1849.   0.113 37.2    0.00486 42.9  -1.48    683. #> 2 FC-1   0.0544   47.2  0.224 16.0    0.00544  8.63 -2.09    802. #> 3 PCIGR1 0.704   229.   0.116 35.8    0.00501 51.2  -1.44    680. #> 4 PL     0.412     9.46 0.536  6.17   0.0144  26.1  -5.82    920.

title: Zircon trace-element geochemistry
text: zircon_ti_t() implements several calibrations. default "watson" Watson & Harrison (2005); "ferry_watson2007" accounts activities SiO2 TiO2, matters rutile absent (aTiO2 < 1).  pressure-dependent calibration Crisp et al. (2023) available equation = "crisp" (pressure GPa), implementation still checked paper.
code: zircons %>%   filter(ti49 > 0) %>%   mutate(     `Watson & Harrison 2005` = zircon_ti_t(ti_ppm = ti49),     `Ferry & Watson 2007, aTiO2 = 1` = zircon_ti_t(ti_ppm = ti49, equation = "ferry_watson2007"),     `Ferry & Watson 2007, aTiO2 = 0.6` = zircon_ti_t(ti_ppm = ti49, equation = "ferry_watson2007",                                                       aTiO2 = 0.6)   ) %>%   pivot_longer(starts_with(c("Watson", "Ferry")), names_to = "calibration", values_to = "T_C") %>%   ggplot(aes(T_C, fill = calibration)) +   geom_density(alpha = 0.4, colour = NA) +   facet_wrap(~ sample, scales = "free_y") +   coord_cartesian(xlim = c(500, 1200)) +   labs(x = expression(Temperature~(degree*C)), y = NULL, fill = NULL) +   theme_minimal() +   theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical")

title: Zircon trace-element geochemistry
text: classify_rock_long() applies CART tree Belousova et al. (2002). needs Lu, U, Ta Nb ppm, Hf wt%, Ce/Ce* Th/U.  Caveat. reference zircons assigned known host rocks: Plešovice, potassic granulite, falls mostly “Carbonatite”. implementation tree (thresholds, units branch order) still checked Belousova et al. (2002), treat classifications provisional. classify_rock_long_no_ce() skips Ce/Ce* (useful La Pr detection) classify_rock_short() uses shorter tree based Lu, U, Hf, Y Yb.
code: zr %>%   mutate(hf = ppm_to_percent(hf177),          th_u = approx_th / approx_u) %>%   classify_rock_long() %>%   count(sample, classification) %>%   group_by(sample) %>%   mutate(fraction = n / sum(n)) %>%   ggplot(aes(sample, fraction, fill = classification)) +   geom_col() +   labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of analyses", fill = NULL) +   theme_minimal()

title: Zircon trace-element geochemistry
text: WR_calculator() estimates trace-element content parent melt zircon/melt partition coefficients Chapman et al. (2016). result can normalized fed La/Yb crustal-thickness proxy Profeta et al. (2015):
code: wr <- zircons %>%   filter(sample == "PL") %>%   WR_calculator(element_vector = c(y89, nb93, la139:lu175)) %>%   normalize(tag = "_WR", element_vector = c(y89_WR, nb93_WR, la139_WR:lu175_WR)) %>%   WR_crustal_thickness()  wr %>%   summarise(la_yb_N = median(la139_WR_N / yb172_WR_N, na.rm = TRUE),             thickness_km = median(WR_crust, na.rm = TRUE)) #> # A tibble: 1 × 2 #>   la_yb_N thickness_km #>     <dbl>        <dbl> #> 1    33.1         74.9

title: Getting started with ztR
text: ztR expects lower-case column names made element symbol mass measured isotope, uncertainties column name plus suffix _2s: Concentrations ppm. Uncertainties 2-sigma absolute. Ages Ma. Chondrite-normalized values get suffix _N; whole-rock estimates suffix _WR.

title: Getting started with ztR
text: package ships table reference zircons (91500, Plešovice, FC-1 PCIGR-1) exported Iolite. Iolite names columns like la139_ppm_mean la139_ppm_2se_int; one rename_with() brings ztR convention: object used articles.
code: zircons <- read_csv(system.file("extdata", "stds_zircon.csv", package = "ztR"),                     show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "unique_quiet") %>%   rename_with(~ .x %>%                 str_replace_all("_mean|_ppm", "") %>%                 str_replace_all("_2se_int", "_2s")) %>%   mutate(sample = recode(sample, "91500-G" = "91500", "FC1" = "FC-1"))  zircons %>% count(sample) #> # A tibble: 4 × 2 #>   sample     n #>   <chr>  <int> #> 1 91500   1789 #> 2 FC-1     756 #> 3 PCIGR1    42 #> 4 PL       512

title: Getting started with ztR
text: Every function adds columns, chain:
code: zircons %>%   filter(sample == "PL") %>%   slice(1:5) %>%   normalize(element_vector = c(la139:lu175)) %>%   mutate(eu_eu = anomaly(eu153_N, sm147_N, gd157_N),          t_ti  = zircon_ti_t(ti_ppm = ti49)) %>%   select(sample, eu_eu, t_ti) #> # A tibble: 5 × 3 #>   sample eu_eu  t_ti #>   <chr>  <dbl> <dbl> #> 1 PL     0.403  985. #> 2 PL     0.397 1004. #> 3 PL     0.357 1013. #> 4 PL     0.416  987. #> 5 PL     0.395  993.

code: library(ztR) library(tidyverse)  zircons <- read_csv(system.file("extdata", "stds_zircon.csv", package = "ztR")) %>%   rename_with(~ .x %>% str_replace_all("_mean|_ppm", "") %>% str_replace_all("_2se_int", "_2s"))  zircons %>%   normalize(element_vector = c(la139:lu175)) %>%   mutate(eu_eu = anomaly(eu153_N, sm147_N, gd157_N),          t_ti  = zircon_ti_t(ti_ppm = ti49)) %>%   use_isoplotr(legacy = FALSE)

title: ztR
text: Columns named element isotope mass: la139, ti49, pb206_u238. Uncertainties column suffix _2s, 2-sigma absolute. Concentrations ppm, ages Ma. Normalized values get suffix _N; whole-rock estimates, _WR.

text: Mineral formulae. Deer, W.., Howie, R.. Zussman, J., 1992. introduction rock-forming minerals. Longman, London. package ships garnet, tourmaline epidote analyses book benchmark data. McLennan, S.M., 1985. continental crust: composition evolution. Blackwell ("taylor_mcclennan_1985.csv"). Ratios proxies. * Loucks, R.R., Fiorentini, M.L. Henríquez, G.J., 2020.
